description: This file contains mock implementations of utility functions for testing purposes, specifically overriding system calls such as system(), access(), and v_secure_system() to use a mock object. It references external mock object and includes function implementations that delegate calls to this mock.

methods.name: int system(const char * cmd)
methods.description: Mock implementation of the system() function, delegating call to g_utilsMock object.

methods.name: int access(const char * pathname,int mode)
methods.description: Mock implementation of the access() function, delegating call to g_utilsMock object.

methods.name: int v_secure_system(const char * cmd,...)
methods.description: Mock implementation of the variadic v_secure_system() function, formatting the command and delegating to g_utilsMock object.
